name: silver
description: A keyless local headless browser for AI agents (Playwright; never calls a model or an API). Drives live pages through accessibility-tree snapshots with stable @eN refs: open, click, fill, log in, extract a table to JSON with real links, monitor for change, QA-drive an app, or run a durable multi-step job that survives a crashed agent. The host is the brain; silver is grounded eyes and hands. Needs the `silver` CLI on PATH: npm i -g agent-silver.
